definitions.explanation: A department within a company or organization responsible for planning projects, products, events, or strategies. A common organizational unit in Japanese corporations.

examples.japanese: {企画部|きかくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was assigned to the planning department.

examples.japanese: {企画部|きかくぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}している→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The planning department is coming up with ideas for new products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{企画部|きかくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせて→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: For details about next month's campaign, please inquire with the planning department.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧ (planning) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (department, division). The suffix ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ forms the names of many corporate departments.

COMMON DEPARTMENT NAMES:
- ⟦{営業部|えいぎょうぶ}→営業部：19381_eigyoubu⟧: sales department
- ⟦{総務部|そうむぶ}→総務部：23789_soumubu⟧: general affairs department
- ⟦{人事部|じんじぶ}→人事部：20638_jinjibu⟧: human resources department
- {広報部|こうほうぶ}: PR department
- {経理部|けいりぶ}: accounting department

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {企画部|きかくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{所属|しょぞく}→所属：12750_shozoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to belong to the planning department
- {企画部|きかくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: person in charge in the planning department
- {企画部|きかくぶ}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧: head of the planning department
